stories.title: South Carolina reports increase in infant deaths
stories.summary: A new South Carolina DPH report reveals rising infant mortality, widening racial disparities and an increase in sleep-related infant deaths.

stories.title: South Carolina's 60th Annual Governor's Carolighting set for November 22 at State House
stories.summary: Gov. Henry McMaster will lead his final Governor's Carolighting on November 22 as South Carolina celebrates the holiday tradition's 60th anniversary.

stories.title: Clarendon County woman charged with lottery fraud involving $36,000 in stolen scratch-off tickets
stories.summary: SLED says a former Travel Centers of America employee in Manning stole lottery tickets and redeemed them for $36,000 in prizes.

stories.title: Richland County man sentenced to 5 years in federal prison for cocaine conspiracy
stories.summary: A Richland County man received a 60-month federal prison sentence for his role in a cocaine trafficking conspiracy involving shipments from Puerto Rico.

stories.title: Construction underway on 238-unit residential development near USC in downtown Columbia
stories.summary: Construction is underway on Heyday Columbia, a 238-unit residential development near USC featuring 543 bedrooms and 365 parking spaces.

stories.title: More than half of South Carolina voters cast ballots early in 2026 general election
stories.summary: South Carolina election officials report historic turnout for a gubernatorial election year, with early voting surpassing Election Day voting.

stories.title: SCDOT seeks public input on plan to speed up transportation projects in South Carolina
stories.summary: South Carolina transportation officials are accepting comments through December 16 on a draft manual outlining new environmental review responsibilities.

stories.title: East Point Academy announces temporary closure after spike in student flu cases
stories.summary: East Point Academy will close November 17 and 18 after a surge in flu cases, with five classes reporting at least 20% of students absent due to illness.

stories.title: Columbia man dies after industrial accident at Fairfield County business
stories.summary: William Waller, 39, of Columbia, died after becoming trapped in a concrete hopper at Oldcastle APG in Ridgeway, according to the Fairfield County coroner.

stories.title: SCDOT to close Sumter County bridge for repairs beginning November 23
stories.summary: SCDOT will close the Eastern School Road bridge over Bluff Swamp in Sumter County for repairs November 23, with reopening expected November 24.

stories.title: Lt. Gov.-elect Mike Reichenbach resigns from South Carolina Senate ahead of new role
stories.summary: Mike Reichenbach will leave South Carolina Senate District 31 as he prepares to serve as lieutenant governor alongside Gov.-elect Alan Wilson.

stories.title: Gov.-elect Alan Wilson to hold first transition team meeting Tuesday in Columbia
stories.summary: South Carolina Gov.-elect Alan Wilson will hold his first transition team meeting November 17 in Columbia as preparations begin for his administration.
